integrity.euler_basis: Compactly supported Euler characteristic localizes to the fixed locus for algebraic C* actions; projectivity gives ordinary topological Euler characteristic.
integrity.first_public_date_basis: The arXiv record for 0809.3417 lists version 1 on 2008-09-19.
integrity.fixed_point_basis: A diagonal one-parameter subgroup with binary-separated basis weights has coordinate points as the only ambient fixed points.
integrity.membership_basis: At a coordinate point the skew matrix has rank two, so every Pfaffian of size at least four vanishes; size-two Pfaffians are exactly the corresponding coordinate functions.
integrity.object_basis: The source defines ladder Pfaffian ideals as sums of fixed-size Pfaffian ideals on square subladders and defines the corresponding projective varieties.
integrity.primary_slot_basis: The archival source lists Mathematics Subject Classification 14M06 first.

scientific_limitations: Euler characteristic is coarse and does not determine degree, Hilbert series, singularities, or finer cohomology.
The formula concerns the standard ladder presentation by coordinate Pfaffians and does not cover arbitrary linear sections or arbitrary specializations.
The localization proof is short, so an older unindexed observation remains possible.
title: Euler characteristic of every ladder Pfaffian variety is a surviving-coordinate count
